title: Servers
description: Server patching, reboots, risk, applications and capacity for the infrastructure, applications and database teams.

list.name: site
list.label: Site
list.query: SELECT site_label FROM dim_site ORDER BY site_label = 'Ungrouped', site_label

options.content: For the infrastructure, applications and database teams: which servers are behind on patching, waiting on a reboot, carrying the most risk, or running short of disk. Point-in-time (the time picker doesn't apply). **Last patch confirmed** is Falcon's date for the most recent patch it saw installed (the console's Exposure Management > Patches). Hover the **i** on any panel for exactly what it counts.

Monthly patching means anything past **35 days** has missed a cycle. **Reboot pending** = installed but not yet applied. Falcon's patch tracking starts 2 Sep 2025, so the longest figure (~400+ days) means nothing confirmed since then -- it may be longer.

panels.title: Servers (active 7d)

targets.rawSql: SELECT count(*) FROM assets a LEFT JOIN host_patch_status p ON p.aid = a.source_asset_id LEFT JOIN host_insights i ON i.aid = a.source_asset_id LEFT JOIN dash_asset_risk r ON r.source = 'falcon_spotlight' AND r.source_asset_id = a.source_asset_id WHERE a.source = 'falcon' AND NOT a.retired AND a.product_type IN ('server','domain_controller') AND a.last_seen > now() - interval '7 days' AND a.site_label IN ($site)

panels.description: Servers and domain controllers with a Falcon sensor seen in the last 7 days.

panels.title: Not patched 35+ days

targets.rawSql: SELECT count(*) FROM assets a LEFT JOIN host_patch_status p ON p.aid = a.source_asset_id LEFT JOIN host_insights i ON i.aid = a.source_asset_id LEFT JOIN dash_asset_risk r ON r.source = 'falcon_spotlight' AND r.source_asset_id = a.source_asset_id WHERE a.source = 'falcon' AND NOT a.retired AND a.product_type IN ('server','domain_controller') AND a.last_seen > now() - interval '7 days' AND a.site_label IN ($site) AND p.last_patch_confirmed < now() - interval '35 days'

panels.description: Servers whose last patch Falcon confirmed was more than 35 days ago: they've missed at least one monthly cycle.

panels.title: Not patched 90+ days

targets.rawSql: SELECT count(*) FROM assets a LEFT JOIN host_patch_status p ON p.aid = a.source_asset_id LEFT JOIN host_insights i ON i.aid = a.source_asset_id LEFT JOIN dash_asset_risk r ON r.source = 'falcon_spotlight' AND r.source_asset_id = a.source_asset_id WHERE a.source = 'falcon' AND NOT a.retired AND a.product_type IN ('server','domain_controller') AND a.last_seen > now() - interval '7 days' AND a.site_label IN ($site) AND p.last_patch_confirmed < now() - interval '90 days'

panels.description: Servers with no confirmed patch in 90+ days: three or more monthly cycles missed.

panels.title: Reboot pending

targets.rawSql: SELECT count(*) FROM assets a LEFT JOIN host_patch_status p ON p.aid = a.source_asset_id LEFT JOIN host_insights i ON i.aid = a.source_asset_id LEFT JOIN dash_asset_risk r ON r.source = 'falcon_spotlight' AND r.source_asset_id = a.source_asset_id WHERE a.source = 'falcon' AND NOT a.retired AND a.product_type IN ('server','domain_controller') AND a.last_seen > now() - interval '7 days' AND a.site_label IN ($site) AND p.reboot_required

panels.description: Patched but waiting on a restart before the patch takes effect.

panels.title: Up 35+ days

targets.rawSql: SELECT count(*) FROM assets a LEFT JOIN host_patch_status p ON p.aid = a.source_asset_id LEFT JOIN host_insights i ON i.aid = a.source_asset_id LEFT JOIN dash_asset_risk r ON r.source = 'falcon_spotlight' AND r.source_asset_id = a.source_asset_id WHERE a.source = 'falcon' AND NOT a.retired AND a.product_type IN ('server','domain_controller') AND a.last_seen > now() - interval '7 days' AND a.site_label IN ($site) AND a.last_reboot < now() - interval '35 days'

panels.description: Servers not restarted in 35+ days. Windows cumulative updates need a restart, so long uptime usually means patches installed but not applied.

panels.title: Unsupported OS

targets.rawSql: SELECT count(*) FROM assets a LEFT JOIN host_patch_status p ON p.aid = a.source_asset_id LEFT JOIN host_insights i ON i.aid = a.source_asset_id LEFT JOIN dash_asset_risk r ON r.source = 'falcon_spotlight' AND r.source_asset_id = a.source_asset_id WHERE a.source = 'falcon' AND NOT a.retired AND a.product_type IN ('server','domain_controller') AND a.last_seen > now() - interval '7 days' AND a.site_label IN ($site) AND i.os_is_eol

panels.description: Servers on an operating system the vendor no longer patches.

panels.title: Days since last confirmed patch

targets.rawSql: SELECT band AS "Last patched", count(*) AS "Servers" FROM ( SELECT CASE WHEN p.last_patch_confirmed IS NULL THEN '6 never / unknown' WHEN floor(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM now() - p.last_patch_confirmed) / 86400)::int <= 7 THEN '1 within 7 days' WHEN floor(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM now() - p.last_patch_confirmed) / 86400)::int <= 35 THEN '2 8-35 days' WHEN floor(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM now() - p.last_patch_confirmed) / 86400)::int <= 90 THEN '3 36-90 days' WHEN floor(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM now() - p.last_patch_confirmed) / 86400)::int <= 180 THEN '4 91-180 days' ELSE '5 over 180 days' END AS band FROM assets a LEFT JOIN host_patch_status p ON p.aid = a.source_asset_id LEFT JOIN host_insights i ON i.aid = a.source_asset_id LEFT JOIN dash_asset_risk r ON r.source = 'falcon_spotlight' AND r.source_asset_id = a.source_asset_id WHERE a.source = 'falcon' AND NOT a.retired AND a.product_type IN ('server','domain_controller') AND a.last_seen > now() - interval '7 days' AND a.site_label IN ($site)) x GROUP BY band ORDER BY band

panels.description: Servers by how long since Falcon last confirmed a patch installed.

panels.title: Patching by OS version

targets.rawSql: SELECT a.os_version AS "OS", count(*) AS "Servers", percentile_disc(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY floor(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM now() - p.last_patch_confirmed) / 86400)::int) AS "Median days since patched", count(*) FILTER (WHERE p.last_patch_confirmed < now() - interval '35 days') AS "Not patched 35+ d", count(*) FILTER (WHERE p.last_patch_confirmed < now() - interval '90 days') AS "90+ d", count(*) FILTER (WHERE p.reboot_required) AS "Reboot pending", count(*) FILTER (WHERE a.last_reboot < now() - interval '35 days') AS "Up 35+ d", count(*) FILTER (WHERE p.last_patch_confirmed IS NULL) AS "No patch data" FROM assets a LEFT JOIN host_patch_status p ON p.aid = a.source_asset_id LEFT JOIN host_insights i ON i.aid = a.source_asset_id LEFT JOIN dash_asset_risk r ON r.source = 'falcon_spotlight' AND r.source_asset_id = a.source_asset_id WHERE a.source = 'falcon' AND NOT a.retired AND a.product_type IN ('server','domain_controller') AND a.last_seen > now() - interval '7 days' AND a.site_label IN ($site) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC

panels.description: Per OS version: how long since its servers were patched, how many have missed a cycle, are waiting on a reboot or have no patch data (Falcon's patch status covers Windows). The exact build per server is in the Servers table.

options.content: One row per active server. **Crit / High / KEV** = open vulnerabilities from the last nightly rollup. Use the column filters (funnel icon) to cut to one team's servers.

panels.title: Servers

targets.rawSql: SELECT a.hostname AS "Server", a.site_label AS "Site", a.os_version AS "OS", a.kernel_version AS "Build", floor(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM now() - p.last_patch_confirmed) / 86400)::int AS "Days since patched", p.reboot_required AS "Reboot pending", p.pending_patches AS "Pending patches", floor(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM now() - a.last_reboot) / 86400)::int AS "Days up", r.open_critical AS "Crit", r.open_high AS "High", r.open_kev_count AS "KEV", i.disk_used_pct AS "Disk %", i.cpu_avg_pct AS "CPU avg %", i.mem_avg_pct AS "Mem avg %", CASE WHEN a.product_type = 'domain_controller' THEN 'DC' ELSE i.form_factor END AS "Type", a.model AS "Model", a.ous[1] AS "OU", a.last_login_user AS "Last login" FROM assets a LEFT JOIN host_patch_status p ON p.aid = a.source_asset_id LEFT JOIN host_insights i ON i.aid = a.source_asset_id LEFT JOIN dash_asset_risk r ON r.source = 'falcon_spotlight' AND r.source_asset_id = a.source_asset_id WHERE a.source = 'falcon' AND NOT a.retired AND a.product_type IN ('server','domain_controller') AND a.last_seen > now() - interval '7 days' AND a.site_label IN ($site) ORDER BY p.last_patch_confirmed NULLS FIRST, r.open_kev_count DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 1500

panels.description: Every active server, worst-patched first. Sort or filter any column; Site and OU help find the owning team.

options.content: Where one change clears the most. Fix titles are Falcon's remediation text.

panels.title: Top missing fixes on servers

targets.rawSql: SELECT vf.fix_title AS "Fix", max(vf.product_family) AS "Product", count(DISTINCT vf.source_asset_id) AS "Servers", count(*) AS "Crit/high findings", count(*) FILTER (WHERE vf.severity = 'critical') AS "Critical" FROM vuln_findings vf JOIN assets a ON a.source = 'falcon' AND a.source_asset_id = vf.source_asset_id AND a.product_type IN ('server','domain_controller') AND NOT a.retired WHERE vf.source = 'falcon_spotlight' AND vf.state IN ('OPEN','REOPENED') AND vf.severity IN ('critical','high') AND a.site_label IN ($site) AND vf.fix_title IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 3 DESC, 4 DESC LIMIT 25

panels.description: The fixes that would close the most critical/high findings on servers, by how many servers each applies to.

panels.title: Applications on servers

targets.rawSql: SELECT vf.product_family AS "Product family", count(DISTINCT vf.source_asset_id) AS "Servers", count(*) FILTER (WHERE vf.severity = 'critical') AS "Critical", count(*) FILTER (WHERE vf.severity = 'high') AS "High" FROM vuln_findings vf JOIN assets a ON a.source = 'falcon' AND a.source_asset_id = vf.source_asset_id AND a.product_type IN ('server','domain_controller') AND NOT a.retired WHERE vf.source = 'falcon_spotlight' AND vf.state IN ('OPEN','REOPENED') AND vf.severity IN ('critical','high') AND a.site_label IN ($site) AND vf.product_family NOT LIKE 'Microsoft Windows OS%' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 25

panels.description: Critical/high findings on servers by product family, excluding the Windows OS itself: what the applications and database teams own.

panels.title: Database and middleware servers

targets.rawSql: SELECT x.hostname AS "Server", x.site_label AS "Site", x.products AS "Products with crit/high", x.crit AS "Critical", x.high AS "High", floor(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM now() - p.last_patch_confirmed) / 86400)::int AS "Days since patched" FROM (SELECT a.source_asset_id, a.hostname, a.site_label, string_agg(DISTINCT vf.product_family, ', ') AS products, count(*) FILTER (WHERE vf.severity = 'critical') AS crit, count(*) FILTER (WHERE vf.severity = 'high') AS high FROM vuln_findings vf JOIN assets a ON a.source = 'falcon' AND a.source_asset_id = vf.source_asset_id AND a.product_type IN ('server','domain_controller') AND NOT a.retired WHERE vf.source = 'falcon_spotlight' AND vf.state IN ('OPEN','REOPENED') AND vf.severity IN ('critical','high') AND a.site_label IN ($site) AND vf.product_family IN ('Microsoft SQL & Data Platform', 'PostgreSQL', 'MySQL / MariaDB', 'Oracle Database', 'Java Runtime (JRE/JDK)', 'Apache Tomcat', 'Microsoft .NET Core / ASP.NET', 'Java / Middleware - Log4j', 'Apache HTTP Server', 'Microsoft Sharepoint') GROUP BY 1, 2, 3) x LEFT JOIN host_patch_status p ON p.aid = x.source_asset_id ORDER BY x.crit DESC, x.high DESC LIMIT 300

panels.description: Servers with open findings in a database or middleware product (SQL Server, PostgreSQL, MySQL, Oracle, Java, Tomcat, IIS/.NET).

options.content: From Falcon's system insights (refreshed nightly): disk is the fullest reported volume, CPU and memory are Falcon's recent averages.

panels.title: Disk 85%+ full

targets.rawSql: SELECT a.hostname AS "Server", a.site_label AS "Site", i.disk_used_pct AS "Disk %", i.disk_free_gb AS "Free GB", i.disk_total_gb AS "Total GB" FROM assets a LEFT JOIN host_patch_status p ON p.aid = a.source_asset_id LEFT JOIN host_insights i ON i.aid = a.source_asset_id LEFT JOIN dash_asset_risk r ON r.source = 'falcon_spotlight' AND r.source_asset_id = a.source_asset_id WHERE a.source = 'falcon' AND NOT a.retired AND a.product_type IN ('server','domain_controller') AND a.last_seen > now() - interval '7 days' AND a.site_label IN ($site) AND i.disk_used_pct >= 85 ORDER BY i.disk_used_pct DESC LIMIT 200

panels.description: Servers with a disk 85% or more used, per Falcon's latest system insights.

panels.title: Busy servers

targets.rawSql: SELECT a.hostname AS "Server", a.site_label AS "Site", i.cpu_avg_pct AS "CPU avg %", i.cpu_max_pct AS "CPU max %", i.mem_avg_pct AS "Mem avg %", round(i.mem_total_mb / 1024)::int AS "RAM GB" FROM assets a LEFT JOIN host_patch_status p ON p.aid = a.source_asset_id LEFT JOIN host_insights i ON i.aid = a.source_asset_id LEFT JOIN dash_asset_risk r ON r.source = 'falcon_spotlight' AND r.source_asset_id = a.source_asset_id WHERE a.source = 'falcon' AND NOT a.retired AND a.product_type IN ('server','domain_controller') AND a.last_seen > now() - interval '7 days' AND a.site_label IN ($site) AND (i.cpu_avg_pct >= 70 OR i.mem_avg_pct >= 90) ORDER BY greatest(i.cpu_avg_pct, i.mem_avg_pct) DESC LIMIT 200

panels.description: Highest average CPU or memory use, per Falcon's system insights.

panels.title: Domain controllers

targets.rawSql: SELECT a.hostname AS "DC", a.site_label AS "Site", a.os_version AS "OS", a.kernel_version AS "Build", floor(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM now() - p.last_patch_confirmed) / 86400)::int AS "Days since patched", p.reboot_required AS "Reboot pending", floor(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM now() - a.last_reboot) / 86400)::int AS "Days up", r.open_critical AS "Crit", r.open_high AS "High", r.open_kev_count AS "KEV", i.os_is_eol AS "Unsupported OS" FROM assets a LEFT JOIN host_patch_status p ON p.aid = a.source_asset_id LEFT JOIN host_insights i ON i.aid = a.source_asset_id LEFT JOIN dash_asset_risk r ON r.source = 'falcon_spotlight' AND r.source_asset_id = a.source_asset_id WHERE a.source = 'falcon' AND NOT a.retired AND a.product_type IN ('server','domain_controller') AND a.last_seen > now() - interval '7 days' AND a.site_label IN ($site) AND a.product_type = 'domain_controller' ORDER BY i.os_is_eol DESC NULLS LAST, p.last_patch_confirmed NULLS FIRST

panels.description: Every domain controller: the servers whose compromise is everyone's compromise.

options.content: Machines Falcon Discover found that are confirmed real and in use but have no sensor: not patch-tracked, not scanned, not protected, so they're in none of the panels above. Network-only devices (unconfirmed) are on the Endpoint & Identity dashboard.

panels.title: Servers with no sensor

targets.rawSql: SELECT COALESCE(hostname, '(no hostname)') AS "Name", CASE discovery_class WHEN 'domain_controller_no_sensor' THEN 'Domain controller, no sensor' WHEN 'server_no_sensor' THEN 'Windows server, no sensor' WHEN 'workstation_no_sensor' THEN 'Windows workstation, no sensor' WHEN 'cloud_no_sensor' THEN 'Cloud instance, no sensor' WHEN 'vmware_nic' THEN 'VMware NIC seen on network' WHEN 'network_device' THEN 'Device seen on network' WHEN 'appliance_ad_account' THEN 'Appliance with an AD account' WHEN 'duplicate_of_managed' THEN 'Same name as a managed host' WHEN 'secondary_ip_of_managed' THEN 'Extra IP of a managed host' WHEN 'service_account' THEN 'Service account (gMSA/MSA)' WHEN 'cluster_name' THEN 'Cluster / listener name' WHEN 'out_of_scope' THEN 'Outside this Falcon tenant' WHEN 'disabled_ad_account' THEN 'Disabled AD computer account' WHEN 'stale_ad_account' THEN 'AD account, no logon in 60+ days' ELSE COALESCE(discovery_class, 'unclassified') END AS "Class", site_label AS "Site", os_version AS "OS", last_seen::date AS "Last AD logon", ad_created::date AS "AD account created", array_to_string(ips, ', ') AS "IPs", description AS "AD description", ous[1] AS "OU" FROM assets WHERE source = 'falcon_unmanaged' AND NOT retired AND site_label IN ($site) AND discovery_class IN ('domain_controller_no_sensor', 'server_no_sensor', 'cloud_no_sensor') ORDER BY CASE discovery_class WHEN 'domain_controller_no_sensor' THEN 1 WHEN 'server_no_sensor' THEN 2 ELSE 3 END, site_label, hostname

panels.description: DCs and Windows servers with an enabled AD account that logged on in the last 60 days, plus cloud instances, that have no Falcon sensor. Install one, or record why not. Classified by collectors/falcon_hosts.py.
